title: The Duck Pack DARK MODE
description: This project is the same as the duck pack but dark mode and making the entire hud, panorama, widget buttons, and interface backgrounds dark.
body: This pack does the exact same thing as the first duck pack except dark. It has a bedrock background when going into any sub menu. It has black widget buttons. It has a the same panorama but a nighttime version. The other parts of the gui like inventory, openable blocks have dark mode. [JOIN MY DISCORD](https://discord.gg/PAGJ9c9RzR)
